adjudication.rationale: In `Admin::GroupsController#add_members`, the loop `usernames.split(",").each` only adds when `User.find_by_username(username)` returns a user; unknown/misspelled usernames are silently skipped and the action still renders `success_json` as long as `group.save` succeeds. This is verifiable in the diff and can mislead callers into thinking all provided usernames were added, but it’s primarily an API/UX/validation design concern rather than a clear correctness defect.
